name: How can I prevent future septic line issues after a repair?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future septic line issues after a repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent future septic line issues, regular maintenance is key. This includes being mindful of what goes down your drains—avoid flushing non-biodegradable items, excessive grease, or harsh chemicals. It's also important to have your septic tank pumped every 3-5 years, depending on household size and usage. Additionally, planting trees and shrubs at a safe distance from your septic system can prevent root intrusion, a common cause of damage. CG Plumbing Solutions can provide guidance on a suitable maintenance schedule for your system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent future issues by avoiding non-biodegradable waste, excessive grease, or harsh chemicals in drains. Schedule regular septic tank pumping and plant trees away from the system.
